releaseName: What-If controls you can actually land on
notes: What-If sliders now have a tap-to-type number, − / + buttons and one-tap presets — drag to explore, type to be exact.
Sliders no longer lose their position when your thumb drifts off the track, and the stops are wide enough to hit on a phone.
The Monthly Payoff Budget field has the same − / + buttons and presets.
